segments.he:
מדבר ממעלת ההתבודדות:
מצאתי כתב יד החברים. שאמר שטוב יותר שההתבודדות יהיה מחוץ לעיר במקום עשבים כי העשבים גורמים שיתעורר הלב (תטו):
segments.en:
Without Hisbodidus One Will Be Confused When Mashiach Comes

I heard in his name that he said: Certainly there are upright people even though they do not have hisbodidus. But I call them "fleytis" — rushed and confused. And suddenly when Mashiach comes and calls them, they will be flustered and confused. But we — we will be like a person after sleep whose mind is calm and well-settled. So too our minds will be calm and well-settled upon us without tumult or confusion.
